reason: The numbers reproduce exactly and the sign is positive in every split I can build (all date/time halves, every day, every game-cluster definition: by event 18 clusters [+2.05, +4.74], by player 30 [+2.08, +4.45], by startDay|league 6 [+2.74, +5.18]; leave-one-game-out range +3.07 to +4.05; the lead x threshold grid is smooth and monotone, not a cliff: lead<=360 with -0.5pt/-1pt/-2pt = 3.55/3.30/3.04, 6h with no edge clause 2.56, 24h no clause 1.38), so it is not an arithmetic error or a look-ahead bug (atMs==firstSeenMs; the book page was read within 3 min of the first look for 71 of 75 bets, median 0.27 min; only 2 of 39 kept bets were read 2.4-3.1 h later). But I am not convinced it is a credible improvement worth putting to Tj as a recommendation, for these reasons. (1) Both halves of the rule rest on a handful of tail closes: the falling-edge clause removes only 5 closes within 6 h, one of them (-9.3%) carrying the effect, and ALL 9 flagged within-6h bets are Under props (0 of 18 Overs; mean dEV Over +1.44 pts vs Under -0.39 pts, so the flag is partly a side/devig artefact); the 6 h clause removes 4 of the 6 closes <= -6.5%, two of them (-30.6%, -20.7%) NFL Overs; long-lead bets beat the close as often as short ones (68% vs 72%) and in the early version era (v0.57-0.59.0, Oct 3) long-lead closes were +1.23% [-1.37, +3.42] (21 closes). Excluding the six tail closes the kept-minus-dropped gap is 1.5 pts, not 4.1. (2) There is no real out-of-sample: the -1 pt and the kept set were chosen on these 2.26 days; the by-date second half is 10 bets/4 games kept and only 3 dropped bets/2 games (one is the -30.6%), so its +13.9 pt kept-minus-dropped gap [-1.68, +21.7] says nothing; the first half alone gives +2.76 [+0.77, +5.10]. (3) The evidence is one regime: 20 of 34 kept closes are app v0.59.1 on Oct 4 (21 of 34 are NFL on the Oct 4 Sunday slate); dropped bets are mostly Oct 3 older versions (16 of 36 bets on Oct 3 vs 3 of 39 kept). (4) The closes are soft: 27 of 34 kept closes are Tracker closes read from CNO's own books for bets Tj placed (kept bets placed 27/39 vs dropped 16/36, so the close source is itself selected by the decision path), 6 are Novig-trades, 1 is Pinnacle, 0 ESPN. CLV here mostly measures whether CNO's consensus held, not whether a sharp close was beaten. Within Tracker closes kept +3.74% (27) vs dropped -1.45% (16, median +2.58 vs +4.82); within Novig-trades closes +1.50% (6) vs -0.02% (14). (5) The builder's own multiplicity-corrected luck figure after 107 tries is 0.20-0.45, i.e. not distinguishable from luck; ROI points the other way (kept -11.8% [-52, +38] vs dropped +2.1%), uninformative at SE ~17 pts. Positive note for a question to Tj, not an action: inside 6 h the page-vs-list edge gap correlates with CLV (Spearman +0.45, p=0.004, 39 closes; +0.41 close_ok n=33; +0.41 without the -9.3% bet; Unders +0.63 n=23, Overs +0.14 n=16; Novig-trades-only +0.22 n=20 p=0.36), so a shadow-logged check is worth keeping. What would settle it: per-bet CLV SD is 6.5% (kept 3.5, dropped 8.3); a 3-pt gap needs about 110 closes per group (design effect 1.5), a 1.5-pt gap about 440. Long-lead (>6h) closes arrive about 11 a day (25 in 2.26 days), so ~110 takes about 10 days; falling-edge-within-6h closes arrived 5 in 2.26 days, so ~110 would take about 50 days at this rate.
caveats: Both halves of the rule are tail-driven: 6 closes <= -6.5% (5 dropped, 1 kept) explain most of the kept-minus-dropped gap (4.08 pts -> 1.5 pts without them).
Falling-edge clause: only 5 closes within 6 h (2 close_ok), one at -9.3%; all 9 flagged within-6h bets are Under props; marginal gain over the 6 h guard alone is +0.74 pts (2.56 -> 3.30).
No true holdout: thresholds and kept set come from the same 2.26 days; by-date second half has 4 kept games and 2 dropped games.
Evidence concentrated in one regime: 20 of 34 kept closes are v0.59.1 on Oct 4; 21 of 34 NFL on the Oct 4 slate.
Closes are mostly Tracker (CNO's own books) read for bets Tj placed (27 of 34 kept closes), 1 Pinnacle close; CLV mostly measures consensus persistence.
All 75 base bets are PROP; the 'PROP/MONEYLINE/SPREAD' list in the expr is moot (0 moneyline/spread bets have a book page).
Builder's 3.62/3.12 halves are an unequal 12/22 split by game start time, not an equal by-date split; by-date halves are 2.94 (14 games) / 4.46 (4 games).
Per-day rate 17.3 averages Sat partial (3) + Sunday NFL slate (26) + Monday (10); a typical non-NFL-Sunday day will likely be lower.
Tail ROI check: kept ROI -11.8% vs dropped +2.1%; neither supports nor refutes at this size (SD per bet 1.05).
Multiple testing across the builder's 107 tries was not re-run by me; builder's own figure is 0.20-0.45 chance some rule looks this good by luck.
Any adoption is a QUESTION for Tj (6 h vs his 24 h trap guard is a tightening, not a loosening); it needs ~110 long-lead closes (~10 days) to settle the lead-time half.
